name: CNC Machining & CAM
summary: Programming and running computer-numerically-controlled machine tools, by hand in G-code and from CAD models with CAM software.

topics.name: CNC machine architecture: axes, drives, spindles and controllers
Coordinate systems, work offsets and tool-length compensation
G-code and M-code programming by hand
Canned cycles, subprograms and parametric (macro) programming
CAM workflow: stock, setups, toolpaths and post-processors
2.5D milling strategies: facing, pocketing, contouring, drilling
Feeds and speeds, chip load and tool deflection
Toolpath simulation, verification and collision checking
Other CNC processes: routers, laser, plasma, waterjet and wire EDM
